constructive_lemmas: Every pairwise Horn equality consequence x XOR y = 0 over a supplied shared set is discoverable by two polynomial Horn clause-entailment checks with replayable least-model conflict traces.
All discovered equality consequences can be compressed to a proof-carrying spanning forest with at most |S|-1 emitted alias rows.
For satisfiable Horn formulas, every entailed pairwise disequality x XOR y = 1 already fixes x and y to one opposite orientation and adds no power beyond complete unary propagation.
Certified Horn equality rows may be injected into the affine module and can close equality/disequality conflicts missed by constants-only negotiation.
discovery_bound: O(|S|^3 * HornSolve(H)) under deterministic rescanning, with every native call and clause scan charged
decisive_obstructions: Binary implication-graph SCC extraction is incomplete for arbitrary Horn formulas because ternary Horn rules can be load-bearing in an equality proof.
Pairwise disequality extraction does not enlarge the fact algebra beyond unary consequences for satisfiable Horn formulas.
Pairwise aliases remain incomplete on NAND3 plus NEQ reduction images.
forbidden_promotions: a complete pairwise basis decides unrestricted Horn-affine mixtures
all pairwise consequences must be stored instead of a spanning basis
binary SCC reachability is complete for arbitrary Horn entailment
polynomial certificate replay implies polynomial consequence discovery
finite random controls establish universal completeness
fixed unsupported arity is a universal polynomial route
claim_boundary: Complete unary and pairwise Horn-equality negotiation only; unrestricted Horn-affine SAT and P versus NP remain open.
